intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} are both public engineering colleges in {{cityA}}, Kerala, and both admit through KEAM on our records. This page compares recorded {{course}} fees and 2023 placements, and it flags where official notices disagree with our table.
College of Engineering Trivandrum vs SCTCE is a local government-college choice. The short title shortens both names; use the table names when you read the numbers.

sections.heading: CET Thiruvananthapuram vs SCTCE for B.Tech / B.E.: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose College of Engineering Trivandrum if you want the larger public campus, with a 2023 second-shift CSE record of ₹7 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest, after you have checked the official fee circular.
Choose SCTCE if you want a smaller public campus in the same city, with a 2023 CSE record of ₹5 lakh average and ₹6 lakh highest, and recorded year tuitions between ₹79,030 and ₹91,550.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: Our table lists ₹2 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for several CET B.Tech branches. That does not match the official 2026 admission circular we opened, which asks general students to pay ₹13,426 at admission, including ₹7,295 tuition, plus a ₹1,575 caution deposit.

Treat the official CET circular as the government admission fee. The ₹2 lakh row may be a different quota or a mislabelled total, so do not use it as the default government fee until the college confirms it.

For SCTCE we hold four tuition year figures for the same branches: ₹79,030, ₹82,990, ₹87,140 and ₹91,550. We have not added them into a four-year official total. Confirm the current KEAM fee on sctce.ac.in.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: CET has a 2023 row for second-shift Computer Science of ₹7 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest. SCTCE has a 2023 CSE row of ₹5 lakh average and ₹6 lakh highest. These are historical records, not promises.
If you need a 2025 branch-wise report, ask both placement cells. A second-shift CET row should not be stretched to every CET branch.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Both colleges are listed with KEAM. Follow the Commissioner for Entrance Examinations process and the college admission instructions for 2026.
CET has an old NIRF Engineering row from 2018, at 75, and no later NIRF row on this page. SCTCE has no NIRF row here. Do not treat the 2018 figure as a 2025 rank.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Thiruvananthapuram, so a local student can visit them on the same day.

CET is the older, larger government engineering college in the city, with a wider branch list including second-shift programmes. SCTCE is also public, with a shorter branch list that includes automobile and biotechnology.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick College of Engineering Trivandrum if the larger campus and the 2023 CSE record of ₹7 lakh average matter more, and you have confirmed the official government fee rather than our ₹2 lakh row.
Pick SCTCE if the smaller public campus and the 2023 CSE record of ₹5 lakh average fit you, after you check the official year tuition.
Both admit through KEAM. Let branch, official fee and a fresh placement report decide, not the short names in the title.

faqs.question: What is the official B.Tech fee at College of Engineering Trivandrum?
faqs.answer: The official 2026 admission circular we opened asks general students to pay ₹13,426 at admission, including ₹7,295 tuition. Our table also shows a ₹2 lakh year total, which does not match that circular, so confirm the quota and official notice before you pay.

faqs.question: What B.Tech fees are on record for SCTCE?
faqs.answer: We hold year tuitions of ₹79,030, ₹82,990, ₹87,140 and ₹91,550 on several branches. These are year figures, not a confirmed four-year official total. Check sctce.ac.in.

faqs.question: How do 2023 placements compare?
faqs.answer: CET has a 2023 second-shift CSE row of ₹7 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest. SCTCE has a 2023 CSE row of ₹5 lakh average and ₹6 lakh highest. These are historical figures.

faqs.question: Which exam do these colleges use?
faqs.answer: Both are listed with KEAM. Follow the official Kerala engineering counselling process for 2026.

faqs.question: Does CET have a current NIRF Engineering rank on this page?
faqs.answer: No current rank is listed. The only NIRF Engineering row here is from 2018, at 75. SCTCE has no NIRF row on this page.

faqs.question: Are both colleges government institutions in Thiruvananthapuram?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our records list both College of Engineering Trivandrum and SCTCE as public colleges in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
